decisions.reason: As a close-fit equipment product with its own page and clear relevance to the firm's integrated laboratory workflow, it remains a low-cost option to keep open while demand continues to be learned.

Because the orthopedic shoe last is distant from the firm's core dental and hearing-system business, its strategic fit is weak and the firm is better off reallocating resources to stronger, nearer-to-core options.

The post-curing unit complements the firm's digital manufacturing chain and can be retained as a promising adjacent option, even if its limited website prominence suggests customer traction is still being tested.
